verified_behavior: Resume and cover-letter DOCX/PDF/TXT outputs are individually written to same-directory temporary files, fsynced, and renamed; a whole revision is published from hidden staging only after format validation.
An abrupt worker exit during a new revision leaves prior bytes and document-history rows intact and does not expose a partial next revision at its final path.

The explicit local CLI inventories recognized orphan revisions, answer exports, failed staging directories, and stale temporary files; referenced records, uploads, debug captures, unknown files, symlinks, and mixed-content revision directories remain protected.

Quarantine records digest/size/path metadata, moves rather than deletes eligible data, and records audit events. Restore validates digest and managed destination layout, refuses collisions, and retains history. Purge honors the 30-day default, requires at least one day via CLI, validates integrity, and records request/completion separately.
The workflow uses no browser automation against employers, AI provider, real application submission, or automatic cleanup worker. External submission remained OFF.
limitations: No PostgreSQL/Docker or hosted test was run for this slice; hosted evidence is NOT_RUN under current policy.
Retention is an explicit maintenance command. Automatic background cleanup and the wider original MJ-REQ-170 retention contract remain incomplete.
Full original requirement and release acceptance remain PARTIAL; this PASS is scoped to MJ-REF-017 issue acceptance only.
Local npm reported one high-severity dependency advisory and a Node engine mismatch; dependency triage/build under the project-declared Node major remains outstanding.
